# Deep Tutor Pro {{VERSION}}

Deep Tutor Pro {{VERSION}} keeps itself up to date and lets tutors create their own account.

## What’s new

- **Automatic updates.**
  - **Windows:** updates download in the background and install when you choose **Restart now**, or the next time you close the app.
  - **Android:** a banner tells you when a new version is out, and **Download update** gets it.
  - **Web:** each new version is used the next time you open the app, or straight away with **Update now**.
  - Your work is saved before every update.
- **Create your own account.** Under **Settings › Account & server**, choose **Create an account** to get a private account on the DeepTutor server, with your own workspace and cloud copy. No administrator is needed.

## Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Deep-Tutor-Pro-{{VERSION}}-Windows-x64-Setup.exe` | Windows 10/11 (64-bit) installer |
| `Deep-Tutor-Pro-{{VERSION}}-Android.apk` | Android 7.0 or later (install from file) |
| `deep-tutor-pro-web-{{VERSION}}.zip` | Web build: unzip and serve the folder from any static web server |
| `latest.yml`, `*.blockmap` | Update feed used by installed Windows copies |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums for the installers and the web zip |

## Notes

- **Windows:** install 2.2 by hand once, over 2.1. Later versions arrive automatically.
- **Android:** an update installs over the existing app only when both are signed with the same key. See the Signing section below.
